about: Seeded accessibility defects in audit-page.html. Judges compute recall against these and note credible extra findings separately.

defects.issue: html element has no lang attribute
nav items and Pay now are clickable divs, not links or buttons, so not focusable or announced
cart icon image has no alt and no accessible name, click-only
headings are styled divs, no h1 or h2
inputs use placeholder only, no labels; hint not associated
hint text #aaa on white fails 4.5:1; white on #4f9cff button fails
required fields indicated by red color only
generic 'Invalid' error not tied to a field and not announced
auto-moving carousel with no pause control
60-second session timeout reloads with no warning or way to extend
20 px cart icon and small 12 px button with 4 px padding
